tips.0: The best times to post are between 6pm and 9pm on weekdays and 10am-12pm on weekends.
tips.1: Use between 5 and 15 hashtags per post. Too many hashtags can look like spam to the algorithm.
tips.2: Posting 3 to 5 times a week to the feed is the ideal pace for small stores. Consistency matters more than volume.
tips.3: Mix large (+1M), medium (100k-500k) and niche (-50k) hashtags. The combination increases your reach.
tips.4: Reply to all comments within 1 hour of posting. The algorithm favors posts with fast engagement.
tips.5: Stories should be posted every day, even when the feed takes a break. Stories keep you at the top of the list.
tips.6: Reuse posts that performed well. If a product sold a lot, create a variation of the same content 2 months later.
tips.7: The first line of the caption is decisive. It appears before "see more", make it spark curiosity or urgency.

privacidade.title: Privacy Policy

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Biztrivo respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and share your personal information in compliance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD - Lei 13.709/2018) and other applicable legislation.
s1.p2: This policy applies to all users of the Biztrivo platform, including visitors, registered users and subscribers of paid plans.
s1.p3: By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, please do not use our services.

s2.title: 2. Definitions
s2.p1: For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:
items: Personal Data: Any information related to an identified or identifiable natural person
Data Subject: The natural person to whom the personal data refers
Controller: Biztrivo, responsible for decisions regarding the processing of personal data
Processing: Any operation carried out with personal data (collection, storage, use, sharing, etc.)
Cookies: Small text files stored on your device to improve your experience

s1.p1: We collect the following information when you create an account or use our services:
items: Registration Data: Store name, email, password (encrypted), phone number
Profile Data: Profile picture, configuration preferences
Payment Data: Billing information (processed by secure third parties)
Business Data: Products, prices, financial transactions, inventory
Communications: Messages sent to support, feedback, reviews

s2.p1: When you use our platform, we automatically collect:
items: Browsing Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, language
Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent, clicks, features used
Device Data: Unique device identifier, model, screen resolution
Location Data: Approximate location based on IP (we do not collect GPS)
Cookies and Similar Technologies: As described in section 10

s3.p1: We may receive information about you from payment processors (such as Stripe, Inc.) when you subscribe to a paid plan, limited to what is necessary to process the transaction.

s4.title: 4. Legal Basis and Purposes of Processing

items: Create and manage your account
Provide the platform's services
Process payments and manage subscriptions
Enable the creation and management of your online storefront
Generate reports and analytics for your business

s2.p1: Based on our legitimate interest, we use your data to:
items: Improve and personalize our services
Conduct statistical analysis and market research
Prevent fraud and ensure platform security
Detect and fix technical errors
Send communications about important service updates

s3.p1: With your express consent, we may:
items: Send promotional emails and special offers
Carry out direct marketing
Use non-essential cookies
Share information for targeted advertising purposes
s3.p2: You may withdraw your consent at any time through your account settings or unsubscribe links in emails.

s4.p1: We may process your data to:
items: Comply with tax and accounting obligations
Respond to requests from competent authorities
Exercise rights in legal proceedings

s5.title: 5. Data Sharing
s5.p1: We do not sell your personal data. We may share your information only in the following situations:

s1.p1: We share data with third parties who help us provide our services:
items: Payment Processors: Stripe, Inc. (to process transactions)
Hosting Services: Cloud infrastructure providers
Analytics Tools: Google Analytics (anonymized data)
Email Services: Transactional email delivery platforms
Customer Support: Support and helpdesk tools
s1.p2: All service providers are carefully selected and contractually required to protect your data and use it only as instructed by us.

s2.p1: We may disclose your data when required by law or in response to:
items: Judicial or administrative orders
Investigations by competent authorities
Protection of our legal rights
Prevention of fraud or illegal activities

s3.p1: In the event of a merger, acquisition, sale of assets or bankruptcy, your personal data may be transferred to the successor entity, which will remain bound by this Privacy Policy.

s4.p1: We may share your data with third parties for other purposes with your express and specific consent.

s1.p1: We keep your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described, including:
items: Active Account Data: For the entire duration of the account
Closed Account Data: For up to 5 years after closure (legal obligations)
Tax/Accounting Data: For the legally required period (generally 5 years)
Marketing Data: Until you withdraw consent or 2 years of inactivity
Access Logs: For up to 6 months (in accordance with the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework)
s1.p2: After these periods, your data is anonymized or deleted in a secure and irreversible manner.

s2.p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
items: Encryption of data in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
Strict access controls and two-factor authentication for employees
Continuous security monitoring and intrusion detection
Regular backups and disaster recovery plans
Periodic security audits
Regular staff training on data protection
Passwords stored with cryptographic hashing (bcrypt)
s2.p2: Despite our efforts, no system is 100% secure. You should also protect your credentials and notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

s3.p1: Your data is stored on servers located in Brazil. Should international transfer be necessary, we will ensure adequate safeguards for protection in accordance with the LGPD.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights as a Data Subject
s7.p1: Under the LGPD, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Confirmation and Access: Confirm whether we process your data and access your information
Correction: Request correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data
Anonymization, Blocking or Deletion: Request anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary, excessive data or data processed in noncompliance
Portability: Request the portability of your data to another provider (structured format)
Data Deletion: Request deletion of data processed based on consent
Information on Sharing: Know which entities we share your data with
Information on the Possibility of Not Consenting: Be informed about the possibility of not giving consent and its consequences
Withdrawal of Consent: Withdraw consent at any time
Objection: Object to processing carried out based on legitimate interest
Review of Automated Decisions: Request review of decisions made solely based on automated processing
s7.p2: To exercise any of these rights:
items2: Access your account settings on the platform
Send a written request to our physical address
s7.p3: We will respond to your request within 15 days. We may request additional information to confirm your identity before processing requests.

s8.title: 8. Data of Minors
s8.p1: Our services are not directed at individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we become aware that we have collected data from a minor without appropriate parental consent, we will take steps to delete such information.
s8.p2: Parents or guardians who believe their children have provided personal data should contact us immediately.

s9.title: 9. Links to Third-Party Websites
s9.p1: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites. We recommend that you read the privacy policy of every site you visit.

s1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us improve your experience, understand how you use our services and personalize content.

items: Essential Cookies: Necessary for the basic operation of the platform (authentication, security). They cannot be disabled.
Performance Cookies: Collect anonymous information about how you use the platform for improvements.
Functionality Cookies: Remember your preferences and settings.
Marketing Cookies: Track your browsing to display relevant ads (only with consent).

s3.p1: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect the platform's functionality.

s11.title: 11. Security Incidents
s11.p1: In the event of a security incident that could result in relevant risk or damage to data subjects:
items: We will notify the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) within an appropriate timeframe
We will inform affected data subjects about the incident and the measures taken
We will take immediate action to mitigate damage and prevent further incidents

s12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
s12.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of material changes through:
items: Email sent to your registered address
A prominent notice on the platform
A notification upon login
s12.p2: The date of the last update will always be indicated at the top of this policy. We recommend that you review this page periodically.

s13.title: 13. Data Protection Officer (DPO)
s13.p1: We have appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) in accordance with the LGPD. Our DPO is responsible for accepting complaints and communications from data subjects, providing clarifications and taking action.
items: Email: biztrivo@outlook.com
Address: 100% remote company, no physical headquarters

s14.title: 14. Data Protection Authority
s14.p1: Without prejudice to any administrative or judicial remedy, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD):
items: Website: www.gov.br/anpd
Address: SAS, Quadra 6, Conjunto A, Bloco A, Ed. Órgãos Regionais, 1º Andar, Brasília-DF, CEP 70070-600

s15.title: 15. Contact Information
s15.p1: For questions, requests or complaints about this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data:
items: General Email: biztrivo@outlook.com
Privacy Email: biztrivo@outlook.com.br
DPO Email: biztrivo@outlook.com
Address: 100% remote company, no physical headquarters
Company ID (CNPJ): 63.526.345/0001-01

s16.title: 16. Cookie Policy (LGPD)
s16.p1: In compliance with the LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018), we use cookies and similar technologies only with your authorization, except when strictly necessary for the service to function. When you access the platform for the first time, we display a consent banner where you can accept or decline the use of non-essential cookies.
items: Essential: Always active. Necessary for authentication, session, security and basic preferences. Without them the platform does not work.
Analytics: Help us understand how you use Biztrivo (e.g., Google Analytics). Only activated after your consent.
Advertising: Allow us to display more relevant content and ads (e.g., Google Ads). Only activated after your consent.
s16.p3: You can withdraw your consent at any time by clearing your browser's cookies or contacting us by email at biztrivo@outlook.com.br. Declining non-essential cookies does not prevent you from using the platform.
s16.p4: We have implemented Google Consent Mode v2, ensuring that no analytics or advertising data is sent to third parties without your express authorization.

privacidade.commitment: Commitment to Privacy: Biztrivo is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal data with full transparency, security and in compliance with Brazilian data protection legislation. Your data is yours, and you have full control over it.
